comparator.definition: Fourth Universal Definition of Myocardial Infarction (UDMI-4) non-Type-1 set: Type 2 (oxygen supply-demand mismatch), Type 3 (sudden cardiac death with presumed ischaemic features, biomarkers unobtained or unobtainable ante-mortem), Type 4a (percutaneous-coronary-intervention-related, periprocedural), Type 4b (stent thrombosis), Type 4c (in-stent restenosis), Type 5 (coronary-artery-bypass-graft-related).

score_semantics.C_score: 0-100. Non-Type-I responsiveness. HIGHER IS WORSE for Type-I specificity: it measures how strongly the same analyte moves in non-Type-I MI settings, i.e. how much of its signal is NOT specific to atherothrombosis.
score_semantics.R_score: 0-100. Plaque-rupture / atherothrombotic (Type-I) responsiveness. Unchanged in definition from the Type-I-vs-Type-II build; not re-harvested.
score_semantics.D_score: -3..+3. Direct head-to-head differential between Type-I MI and any non-Type-I subtype. Positive = higher in Type I.
score_semantics.magnitude: 0-3 per axis. 0 = no change, 1 = minor/inconsistent change, 2 = moderate consistent change, 3 = large change comparable to or exceeding its Type-I rise.

comparator.no_evidence_convention: Absence of evidence is recorded as evidence='none' with magnitude=null and is EXCLUDED from the C denominator. It is never coerced to zero. Axes with no retrievable evidence render as em-dash in the UI.

axes.coverage_caveat: All 325 molecules queried and extracted. The 5 molecules skipped by an upstream token ceiling were completed in a follow-up pass; 3 of them (TGF-beta1, KIM-1, progesterone) returned magnitude-2 human evidence.

class_thresholds.rule: C>=50 and R>=50 -> Shared / rises in both; C>=50 and (R<50 or R absent) -> Non-Type-I-associated; C<30 and R>=50 -> Type-I-specific; R and C both absent -> Insufficient evidence; otherwise Indeterminate. Recovered by fitting against the shipped Type-I-vs-Type-II labels: reproduces all 325 Tier-1 rows exactly.

tier2_proxy.method: Tier-2 C recalibrated to the 12-axis comparator by combining the shipped count-proxy C with an LLM mechanism-and-pathway-step estimate over the 5 non-Type-1 setting families. Weights fitted on the 166 Tier-1 molecules with >=50% axis coverage, where the 12-axis C is known.

harvest_audit.rule: axis_spec.no_evidence_convention forbids coercing absence of evidence to zero. 28 harvested records carried magnitude=0 while their own finding text shows the abstract examined a BASELINE/genotype predictor or an ADMINISTERED agent rather than measuring a change in the analyte caused by the event - i.e. the axis was never assessable, not assessed-and-flat. A spurious 0 both enters the C denominator and pulls C down, so it is directionally harmful. These 28 were reverted to magnitude=null/evidence='none'. The 183 records with magnitude>=1 whose finding text also reads as predictor-only were NOT altered - re-adjudicating an asserted magnitude is re-harvesting, outside this phase - but are disclosed here as a known upper bound on C inflation.

procedural_corpus_sweep.known_false_negative: g_mb (Myoglobin): bare gene symbol MB retrieved CK-MB literature; see sweep artifact
